title: General Material Blend 4-Mix Duo #11 (동심원·물결 / 부채꼴·매끈)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: Emirati, in her mid 40s, cool and composed expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, smoky bronze eyes, a soft nude lip, warm golden-tan skin, an elegant composed expression, bright golden-blonde hair styled in long locs gathered loosely, real pores, real living eyes, 3 studs piercings set with opals in mixed metal-toned metal, wearing two to three pieces of mixed-metal a hair ornament. Fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 48% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 3 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 21%, 39% and 82% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, tiger formations in VIVID ORANGE and STARK BLACK, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries solid polished jade-green stone fused directly into her own form, natural cloudy veining flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING deep jade-green stone surface with VIVID pale-green vein striations. Region 3 is the ring between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING CRIMSON scale formations, VIVID DEEP EMBER scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 4 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it carries butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET scale formations, VIVID MAGENTA scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a perfectly circular course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward, her extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
